snippet.title: Wildkeepers Rising - Full Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Tame monsters! Slay waves of enemy hordes! Explore fantasy lands! 
Wildkeepers Rising is an ✨innovative✨ bullet heaven:
🐉- Collect and fight with a team of creatures
🕹️- Directly control their special abilities
🗺️ - Complex maps, not flat planes
🗡- RPG campaign
👹- Still defeat hordes of enemies!

Get it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2995560/Wildkeepers_Rising/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=rel
